values.note: Lakeside rustic $35, lakefront rustic $40, lakeside 50-amp $50, full hookup $60 (lakeside or creekside), full-hookup pull-through $70; walk-to tent sites $30. values.note: Online booking on the operator's Firefly engine. Cancel or reschedule at least 14 days ahead for a refund less reservation and processing fees; none after. Late arrivals self-register at the contact station. The campground sits in the USACE flood zone, and a reservation cancelled for flooding is refunded in full.

booking.source: https://youghlakecampground.com/faq ('There is a two night stay minimum for weekends. And a three night stay minimum for holiday weekends', cancellation policy) + https://youghlakecampground.com/ ('Book Your Stay Now' -> Firefly), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed fees $35 rustic base to $70 full-hookup pull-through (2026), weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimum. Added 50-amp, water+sewer, 35-55 ft sites with pull-throughs, showers/potable water/dump, season mid-April to mid-October, Firefly online booking and cancellation terms. Not stated: site count, Good Sam (left as derived).
flags: Ownership class: the operator's FAQ says the campground is on the Youghiogheny River Lake, 'a flood-control facility maintained by the US Army Corps of Engineers' with all sites in the USACE flood zone (this is the Corps' Tub Run recreation area, run by a concessionaire). The entry says private; by the curation doc's concessionaire rule (land owner decides) it may belong as federal.
